analysis.title: Vivid Gradient Productivity Landing Page
analysis.notes: A clean white productivity landing page uses oversized black typography and a centered phone hero framed by vivid pink, orange, and purple gradients. Lower sections introduce editorial two-column messaging, compact feature columns, and a saturated photographic image band.
analysis.heroPrompt: Create a photorealistic editorial hero image of a hand holding a modern smartphone upright at a slight angle, centered against a white background. The phone screen shows an abstract luminous gradient of cobalt blue, magenta, coral, orange, and soft white, with realistic glass reflections and subtle depth. Surround the subject with a wide, softly feathered horizontal aura blending pink, purple, and warm orange, fading cleanly into white. Use high-key studio lighting, refined product photography, crisp edges, and generous negative space; no text, logos, or recognizable branding.
